About

I enjoy finding the story behind the numbers and making information easier to understand.

I believe good decisions start with good data. I’m interested in data analysis and technology, and I enjoy turning raw data into something clear, organized, and useful.

I can work on data cleaning, organizing and analyzing data, creating Excel reports and dashboards, and using Python for data analysis and visualization. I’m also interested in AI and how it can be used to solve real problems and make working with data more effective.

I’m detail-oriented, enjoy finding patterns and solving problems, and I’m always looking for opportunities to improve my skills through practical projects and experience. I don’t just deliver a service; I make sure the final result is clear, professional, and tailored to each client’s exact needs, with attention to the small details that make the work stand out. I’m open to connecting, collaborating, and exploring opportunities where I can use my skills and continue to grow.
